record.field: if record.cost > record.meter_id.monthly_budget and record.meter_id.monthly_budget > 0: # Log a next activity on the meter env['mail.activity'].create({ 'res_name': record.meter_id.name, 'res_model_id': env['ir.model']._get('energy.meter').id, 'res_id': record.meter_id.id, 'summary': 'Budget Exceeded Alert', 'note': f"Reading {record.reading_date} has a cost of {record.cost} which exceeds the monthly budget of {record.meter_id.monthly_budget}.", 'user_id': record.meter_id.department_id.manager_id.user_id.id if record.meter_id.department_id.manager_id.user_id else env.user.id, 'activity_type_id': env.ref('mail.mail_activity_data_warning').id, })
